about: Modwerk source-only sample-rate package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/sample-rate.

mods.title: Fine Tune + Sample Rate
mods.summary: TUN turns in cents, press and turn for semitones; FIN's knob is RATE, pure sample speed down to a stop and into reverse, on every sound.
mods.description: TUN turns in cents, press and turn for semitones; FIN's knob is RATE, pure sample speed down to a stop and into reverse, on every sound.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: This source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 from RAM in a test image with the author's private test base (SG02, the automated rig); this package has not run alone on a unit.
